title: W2's second look stops failing every run; the board says the real error, and how old its held count is
why: The session manager, 2026-11-18, from the crawler's Railway logs: GET /api/crawl/verify.php?limit=4 answered 500 'Could not record the verification.' on 5 of 5 runs (18:37–19:17 UTC), so W2's second look did nothing. The endpoint's catch hid the cause, which went only to the server's error log (not mirrored, so it can't be read here). (1) Verify::lease now works each waiting listing on its own: one whose check throws is set aside 6 hours with its error kept on it, logged, and named in the answer ('set_aside'), and the rest still go to the worker. One bad listing no longer stops every run. (2) A failure that still reaches the endpoint answers with its real cause ('Could not hand out listings to verify: <class>: <message>'): the worker's log shows it. (3) The ledger keeps those words, set-aside listings included, and the board's W2 row shows 'Last error' with its time, so a hidden 500 can't hide again. Once live, the next W2 run either works or names its cause on the board at https://traversence.com/admin/config/control#cb-p-wf-W2. (4) Jason read '15 held' as most of the system down, when it came from a pre-flight two hours old while the crawler worked every 5 minutes. The strip's count now says the time of the test behind it ('15 held at the Nov 18, 10:19 AM test, over an hour old') with Test again beside it, and 'Last tested' is renamed 'Newest single check' (it is one line, not the whole test). Tests: w2-verify.php 5 (a listing that throws is set aside with its words, the other handed out, not tripped on again; the board reads the last error); r2b 14, r2d 9 and layout 8 still pass; rendered at 390px with no sideways scroll. Not in this release: the W3 source register reading helsinki.fi and cup.lmu.de (off-region universities): they are registered sources (reference_sources, status 'read'), so whether off-region sources belong is a rule to decide first. Built on Sync 19:23 UTC. No tables or migrations. FAQ: its two lines (the strip's test time, a row's last error) go with release 3a, because comms-all, not live yet, carries faq.md.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
